newsitem.title: MONACO: Lloyd's of London chairman plans U.S. sales drive.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's of London chairman plans U.S. sales drive.

text.p: Lloyd's of London chairman David Rowland is to spearhead a massive marketing campaign in the U.S. aimed at drumming up new business in the wake of acceptance of the society's recovery plan.
Rowland told reporters at the reinsurance rendezvous in Monte Carlo on Monday that around fifty to sixty Lloyd's brokers and underwriters would join him on a grand tour of the U.S. in two weeks time.

They will visit cities such as New York, Chicago and San Franciso to tell brokers and insurance buyers of the strength of the Lloyd's market, its solvency position, and its ability to provide innovative insurance policies.
Rowland will also make a series of personal appearances at major U.S. insurance industry conferences in the next few months.
Rowland said: "We have to identify why Lloyd's has managed to retain business through the worst of times, and sell that asset to the market."
"I believe that asset is the ability of the client to look the underwriter who is assessing his risk in the eye in a face to face situation," he said.
-- Gordon Mackenzie, Reuters Insurance News +377 93 50 65 00 ext 88031
